Siri AI is the major upgrade and highlight of iOS 27 and later, but only newer Apple devices support the completely revamped Siri. Here is the complete hardware list of iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch and Apple Vision Pro that support Siri AI.

Below are the Apple products that support Siri AI in iOS 27 and later

iOS 27 and its companion updates include the long-awaited major Siri revamp, called Siri AI.

Siri AI is only available on compatible hardware (and in specific regions). Here are all the Apple products that support Siri AI.

iPhone

  • iPhone Duo
  • iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max
  • iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max
  • iPhone Air
  • iPhone 17
  • iPhone 17e
  • iPhone 16 Pro and Pro Max
  • iPhone 16 and 16 Plus
  • iPhone 16e
  • iPhone 15 Pro and Pro Max

iPad

  • iPad Pro (M1 chip and newer)
  • iPad Air (M1 chip and newer)
  • iPad mini (A17 Pro)

Mac

  • All models with Apple silicon (M1 chip and newer, as well as A18 Pro chip)

Apple Watch (must be paired with an AI-capable iPhone)

  • Apple Watch Series 9 and newer
  • Apple Watch Ultra 2 and newer
  • Apple Watch SE 3

Apple Vision Pro

  • All models

All of the above products support Siri AI. However, certain aspects of the Siri experience will be even better on specific hardware.

For example, the ability to fully customise the rhythm and expressiveness of the Siri AI voice is only available on certain hardware. Apple says:

The reason for this limitation is that Apple's most powerful on-device AI models are only available on newer products. Users with these models may or may not experience faster Siri AI performance.

Does Siri AI make you want to upgrade to newer Apple hardware? Let us know in the comments.
